cases.name: Provisioning OFF and browser boundary
cases.authorization: Read-only HTTP checks on the named Development app origin with provisioning OFF; no automatic sign-in, refresh or retries.

cases.name: Self-only access discovery
cases.authorization: Read-only contratpro_auth_access GET calls as pre-existing isolated synthetic mapped A/B and unmapped U users; three requests within budget four, independent no-change evidence; no session refresh or fixture creation.

cases.name: Gateway context through nested definers
cases.authorization: Temporary authenticated EXECUTE on only public.contratpro_provision_identity(); pre-existing active mapped synthetic identity; approved non-secret gateway observation mechanism; application provisioning remains OFF.

cases.name: Anonymous, malformed and expired rejection
cases.authorization: Named Development gateway requests with isolated signed test credentials and malformed/expired variants; temporary RPC EXECUTE only; no production keys or signing-key export.

cases.name: Cross-user and privilege boundary
cases.authorization: Temporary RPC EXECUTE only; isolated A/B sessions and accepted read-only catalog evidence. Behavioral direct-write denial probes belong to C06.

cases.name: Existing mapping repeated calls
cases.authorization: Two explicit RPC calls for one pre-existing active mapped synthetic user; temporary RPC EXECUTE only; serialize fixture changes.

cases.name: Fresh identity and two-call concurrency
cases.authorization: Temporary RPC EXECUTE plus creation of bounded synthetic Auth users and canonical rows; two concurrent requests only; separate operator observer and fixture baseline.

cases.name: Disabled and conflicting mappings
cases.authorization: Reviewed synthetic-only fixture writes for disabled/equal-ID/conflicting states; temporary RPC EXECUTE; no existing customer rows or constraint weakening.

cases.name: Rollback without orphan records
cases.authorization: Reviewed disposable Development clone, exact fault point and observer, fixture writes and cleanup plan; no shared-Development trigger/function replacement or global fault injection.

cases.name: Lost-response reconciliation
cases.authorization: Synthetic identity writes, temporary RPC EXECUTE, isolated Development app process, provisioning AND auth-access gate authorization, bounded fault proxy and read-only observer; one separately initiated reconciliation repeat.

cases.name: Post-write expiry reconciliation
cases.authorization: Same C04 boundaries plus controlled token-expiry timing with refresh disabled; no system-clock, production-clock or signing-key changes.

cases.name: Behavioral restricted-role enforcement
cases.authorization: Exact reviewed restricted-session procedure and finite denial statements on disposable synthetic fixtures, transaction rollback and independent observer; attempted writes belong to C even when expected to fail. No capability membership or permanent broad grants.
